notes: No verifiable menu found. The shop has no website, no first-party ordering page and no delivery-marketplace store that could be found (searches for 'Bellwood Sweets' / 'Bellwood Sweet Shop' / 'Bellwood Sweets Shop' at 706 Bellwood Ave turned up no DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Toast, Clover or Square page). Third-party directories confirm the address (706 Bellwood Ave, Bellwood, IL 60104) but carry no menu: Restaurantji (https://www.restaurantji.com/il/bellwood/bellwood-sweets-shop-/) has no menu text or menu photo, only review/blurb mentions of Italian beef, shrimp nachos and chicken nachos with no prices; Atly (https://www.atly.com/location/BellwoodSweetsShop) has an auto-generated description (nachos, tacos, candy) and no items or prices; MapQuest (https://www.mapquest.com/us/illinois/bellwood-sweets-275612061) lists it as a confectionery shop only. The 'website' those directories link (http://bellwood-shop.poi.place/) is an auto-generated placeholder domain, not the shop's own, and was not used. Yelp and Facebook were not opened. Getting a menu will need a phone call or a photo of the in-store board (third-party listings give (708) 493-1455, unverified).
